caveats: Opinion question. Michael->Toby is comic and partly exaggerated, but the show consistently plays it as genuine dislike (the room even objects in S6E23); Toby does not reciprocate. Dwight-Jim is a rivalry that turns into friendship, so 'hatred' there is weaker. Answers about real actors are out of scope.
reference: Judgment, no single answer. Best-supported: Michael's hatred of Toby, the show's most explicit and lasting one-sided hatred: 'Toby is the worst human being I've ever known' (S3E18), 'if I had a gun with two bullets and I was in a room with Hitler, Bin Laden, and Toby, I would shoot Toby twice' (S6E23), framing Toby (Frame Toby, S5E8), and others acknowledge it ('Now I know why Michael hated you so much', S9E1). Other plausible answers: Dwight vs Jim (pranks, 'you married my worst enemy', 'at times, I've even hated your guts', though they end as friends); Angela vs Oscar after the senator affair (she tried to have his kneecap shattered, S9E9); Angela vs Pam/Phyllis.

evidence.line: Michael: No, Toby is terrible. Toby is the worst human being I've ever known.
Michael: ... if I had a gun with two bullets and I was in a room with Hitler, Bin Laden, and Toby, I would shoot Toby twice.
Michael: Why are you the way that you are? ... I hate so much about the things that you choose to be.
Michael: I tried to talk to Toby and be his friend but that is like trying to be friends with an evil... snail.
Andy: Now I know why Michael hated you so much.
Dwight: I do. But you married my worst enemy.
Dwight: Well, Jim, I just want to say that we haven't always got along and at times, I've even hated your guts.
Oscar: ... until she tried to have my kneecap shattered for sleeping with her husband.

question: Which character hated another character the most?
